#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    
    // Split string into runs of identical characters
    std::vector<std::string> runs;
    if (!s.empty()) {
        char current = s[0];
        std::string run = "";
        for (char c : s) {
            if (c == current) {
                run += c;
            } else {
                runs.push_back(run);
                run = std::string(1, c);
                current = c;
            }
        }
        runs.push_back(run);
    }
    
    int ans = 0;
    for (const std::string& r : runs) {
        if ((r.length() & 1) == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
